name: HCS12-v1
limits: Use unbanked low 0x002000 near-relative BSR, not paged CALL. PPAGE/global translation and 24-bit space behavior remain unobserved until actual Java addresses are recorded.
Do not substitute HCS12X/XGATE or treat 16-bit stored return values as proof of flat 24-bit ABI.
cpu_boundary: SDK selection only, no CPU execution
function_truth_origin: manual hand-owned source extent frozen before ProgramDB creation
function_bound_policy: Half-open byte ranges; SuperH includes intrinsic return/call delay slots; Hexagon consists only of complete one-word packets.
